data_and_numerical_evidence.formula: Independent stdlib recomputation used complete paired seed means, sample SD/SE, t=mean/SE and original df4 critical value 2.7764451051977987. The stable exact df4 two-sided tail is .5*q*q*(3-q), q=4/(sqrt(t*t+4)*(sqrt(t*t+4)+abs(t))). Computed card effects/CIs/p values match to floating-point precision.
data_and_numerical_evidence.frozen_gates: Original mean>0, at least4/5 positive, paired-t95% CI lower>0 and reviewed identity/uniform-invariance gates remain the historical requirements; no threshold, seed, metric or control was changed.
data_and_numerical_evidence.IUT: All frozen utility and CE gates must pass for the single conjunction. This supports an intersection-union interpretation regardless of endpoint dependence, not simultaneous95% coverage or separately multiplicity-corrected endpoint discoveries. risks.detail: Conditional paired-t evidence is strong under the original assumptions; five seed units do not establish distribution-free calibration or rare-tail robustness.
Exact two-sided sign-flip p=.0625 remains visible and does not pass .05. The accepted statement is the original parametric gate, not assumption-free confirmation.
Evidence is conditional on the fixed benchmark and frozen pipeline. The L4 classification is a later audit, not a new replication or population generalization.
Uniform capacity mismatch, one frozen permutation family and historical lack of quantum-exclusive superiority remain limits. They do not invalidate the narrower same-checkpoint alignment contrast.

References and declared identities require source-level review. The current exact scientific card has that review, but generic validator success is not a substitute. Publication must preserve the reviewed dependency closure and evidence references.
